title: ProjectionResultV1
description: The generic envelope every projection travels in. It carries the citation (canonical_revision_id), the label (projection_kind), the deterministic digest, and one typed payload. The payload is validated as either shape here; the stronger invariants -- that the kind matches the payload's type, and that the envelope and payload cite the same revision -- are enforced in Python, where a mismatch can be reported as the specific contract violation it is rather than as a failed union branch.

canonical_revision_id.description: The revision this result was derived from. Excluded from the digest's inputs along with projection_id, so two identical renderings of one revision digest identically however they are labelled.

digest.description: sha256 over the payload, excluding the digest itself and projection_id.
